title: 第25章 独战雪狼第26章 幸不辱命
content_zh:
噗通！
陆安从树上跳下来，看着地上的黑色痕迹，眼神微凝，转身继续往山上冲去。
有了火焰傍身，陆安心中多少也有了些底气。为了防止仓促之中没有火焰使用，所以他一路上都在手中升起火焰，以防不时之需。
经过刚刚的袭击后，陆安竟然奇迹般的没有遇到其他的野兽。一路奔驰之后，在夜晚一点左右，他已经跑到能够见到山顶的地方。
此时，阴云已经缓缓散开，天空中的月亮格外明亮。陆安一路狂奔也有些累，尤其要一直在手中保持火焰，让命轮之力并不是很充足的他更加劳累。
突然，陆安的眼睛猛地瞪大，浑身绷紧飞快藏到一棵大树身后！跟着缓缓探出头，朝着山顶看去！
只见山顶那一块突兀的巨石上，一头庞大的狼正站在月光下，用双爪按住一个不停翻腾的青色大鸟。
当陆安见到这头狼的时候，瞬间皱起眉头！
这匹狼，与当日杀死爹娘的狼长得一模一样，只不过个头却要大了一倍，恐怕是一头成年雪狼！
是一头真正的一阶奇兽！
陆安虽然认得雪狼，但并不知道雪狼的能力。事实上，一头普通的一阶雪狼并没有特殊能力，只是在速度和力量上远远超出普通的狼族。尤其是一对獠牙，连成年的老虎在一头雪狼面前都如同猫咪一样弱小。
陆安眼神中透出一丝杀意，因为爹娘的死，他对雪狼这种凶恶的种族有着极大的敌意。但他并没有冲动，而是深吸一口气，看着被雪狼压在爪下不停挣扎的青色大鸟。
只见那青色大鸟的双翅都被雪狼压住，狼爪的锋利已经深深嵌入翅膀之中，鲜血汩汩流了一地，青色大鸟不停挣扎，口中不停发出刺耳的哀叫声。
突然，陆安瞪大眼睛，死死盯着青色大鸟的羽毛之下。在翅膀的不停扇动中，他见到一个棕色水袋就在那巨石上！
深吸一口气，陆安努力让自己冷静下来。他看着雪狼与青鸟，很明显，雪狼占据着绝对上风，青鸟被杀不过是时间的问题。等到雪狼杀死青鸟之后，最多享用一顿美味，应该就会离开。到时候，他再去巨石上取走水袋，再下山回到学院中，也是来得及！
只是……
陆安皱眉看着那挣扎的青色大鸟，听着从它口中传来的阵阵哀嚎，心中就不由得升起一股杀气！
这一幕，让他想起了当日自己的父母丧生在雪狼之下的情景。只见他的眼睛中杀意越来越浓，跟着重重吸了一口气！
杀雪狼！再取走水袋！
陆安顿时下定决心！他看着远处山顶的雪狼，在月光下显得格外庞大。足足有五米长的身躯，陆安知道自己决不能大意！

雪狼毕竟是真正的一阶奇兽，而他虽然能释放命轮，却也最多算是一级天者，这之间差了整整一个等级。要杀死这头雪狼，就要做好一切准备！
陆安算了一下距离，从刚刚投掷火焰来计算，他在这里是绝对无法将火焰扔到雪狼身上。如果想命中，就必须跑到十米以内的地方。
想到这，陆安便悄悄移动，一点点朝着巨石靠近。事实上，一头雪狼的警惕性本来应该可以发现陆安的存在，但此时这头雪狼正忙于制服爪下的青鸟，青鸟也在不停嘶吼着，才让它无法注意到周围的情况。
很快，在陆安几乎无声的前进后，他来到了距离巨石二十米左右的地方。但此时前方已经没有大树可以让他藏身，山顶是一片空地，如果想达到十米的位置，他必须暴露在月光之下！
陆安眼睛凝重，看着远处正普通撕咬嚎叫的巨大雪狼，它的一条腿都比陆安高大粗壮！陆安忍不住倒吸一口气，眼中更加沉静，咬牙从树后慢慢走出。
狼的警觉性极强，这一点陆安很清楚。即便这头雪狼正在与青鸟对峙，他也必须万分小心谨慎。
连呼吸都不敢大声，连落脚都要极轻，陆安一步一步缓慢往前移动。
近了。
更近了。
足足半分钟，陆安才往前移动了八米的距离，他屏住呼吸，手中渐渐升起红色火焰。
而就在这个时候，突然间陆安前进的步伐戛然而止，身体一下子定格在原地，一动不动！
陆安咽了一口口水，瞪大眼睛看着十几米外高大的雪狼，只见那雪狼此时正回头，凶神恶煞的眼珠正死死俯视盯着自己！
“跑！”
陆安心中大喊一声，只见他毫不迟疑，撒腿就跑！而那雪狼见到一个弱小的人类竟然胆敢出现在自己的身后，顿时仰天长啸一声，一下子撒开青鸟，转身朝着弱小的人类扑去！
砰！！
content_en:
Plop!
Lu An jumped down from the tree, looked at the black marks on the ground, his eyes narrowed slightly, then turned around and continued rushing up the mountain.
With the flame by his side, Lu An felt somewhat confident. In order to prevent him from running out of flames in a hurry, he raised flames in his hands along the way just in case of emergency.
After the attack just now, Lu An miraculously did not encounter other beasts. After running all the way, at around 1 o'clock in the night, he had reached the place where he could see the top of the mountain.
At this time, the clouds had slowly dispersed, and the moon in the sky was particularly bright. Lu An was a little tired from running all the way, especially having to keep the flame in his hands all the time, which made him even more tired as he didn't have enough power in the Life Wheel.
Suddenly, Lu An's eyes widened suddenly, and he tensed up and quickly hid behind a big tree! Then slowly poke your head out and look towards the top of the mountain!
On the abrupt boulder on the top of the mountain, I saw a huge wolf standing in the moonlight, holding down a big blue bird that was constantly writhing with its paws.
When Lu An saw this wolf, he instantly frowned!
This wolf looks exactly like the wolf that killed my parents that day, but it is twice as big. I am afraid it is an adult snow wolf!
It is a true first-order strange beast!
Although Lu An recognized Snow Wolf, he didn't know Snow Wolf's abilities. In fact, an ordinary first-level snow wolf has no special abilities, but its speed and strength far exceed those of ordinary wolves. Especially a pair of fangs, even an adult tiger is as weak as a cat in front of a snow wolf.
There was a hint of murderous intent in Lu An's eyes. Because of the death of his parents, he was extremely hostile to such a vicious race as the Snow Wolf. But he did not act impulsively, but took a deep breath and looked at the big blue bird that was struggling under the claws of the snow wolf.
I saw that both wings of the big blue bird were pressed down by the snow wolf, and the sharp claws of the wolf were deeply embedded in the wings. Blood gurgled all over the ground. The big blue bird kept struggling, and kept making harsh whining sounds from its mouth.
Suddenly, Lu An's eyes widened and he stared under the feathers of the big blue bird. As his wings kept flapping, he saw a brown water bag on the boulder!
Taking a deep breath, Lu An tried to calm down. He looked at Snow Wolf and Blue Bird. It was obvious that Snow Wolf had the absolute upper hand and it was only a matter of time before Blue Bird was killed. After the snow wolf kills the blue bird, he will probably have a delicious meal and then leave. By then, it would be too late for him to get the water bag from the boulder and then go back down the mountain to the academy!
Just...
Lu An frowned and looked at the struggling blue bird. Listening to the wails coming from its mouth, he couldn't help but feel a murderous aura in his heart!
This scene reminded him of the day when his parents were killed by a snow wolf. I saw the killing intent in his eyes getting stronger and stronger, and he took a deep breath!
Kill the snow wolf! Take away the water bag again!
Lu An immediately made up his mind! He looked at the snow wolf on the top of the mountain in the distance, which looked particularly huge in the moonlight. With a body of five meters long, Lu An knew that he must not be careless!
After all, the Snow Wolf is a true first-level strange beast, and although he can release the Life Wheel, he can only be regarded as a first-level heavenly being at best. There is a whole level difference between them. To kill this snow wolf, you must be prepared for everything!
Lu An calculated the distance. Judging from the flames he had just thrown, he would never be able to throw the flames at Snow Wolf here. If you want to hit, you must run within ten meters.
Thinking of this, Lu An moved quietly, approaching the boulder little by little. In fact, the vigilance of a snow wolf should have discovered Lu An's presence, but at this time, the snow wolf was busy subduing the blue bird under its paws, and the blue bird kept roaring, so that it could not notice the surrounding situation.
Soon, after Lu An advanced almost silently, he arrived about twenty meters away from the boulder. But at this time there is no big road aheadThe tree allows him to hide, and the top of the mountain is an open space. If he wants to reach ten meters, he must be exposed to the moonlight!
Lu An's eyes were solemn as he looked at the huge snow wolf that was biting and howling in the distance. One of its legs was taller and stronger than Lu An! Lu An couldn't help but take a breath, his eyes became calmer, gritted his teeth and slowly walked out from behind the tree.
Wolves are extremely alert, and Lu An knows this very well. Even if the snow wolf is confronting the blue bird, he must be extremely cautious.
Not even daring to breathe loudly, and even placing his feet very lightly, Lu An moved forward slowly step by step.
Close.
Closer.
It took half a minute for Lu An to move forward eight meters. He held his breath and red flames gradually rose in his hands.
And at this moment, Lu An's progress suddenly stopped, and his body suddenly froze in place, motionless!
Lu An swallowed a sip of saliva and looked at the tall snow wolf more than ten meters away with wide eyes. He saw that the snow wolf was turning back at this time, and its fierce eyes were staring down at him!
"Run!"
Lu An shouted in his heart and saw him running away without hesitation! When the snow wolf saw that a weak human being dared to appear behind him, he immediately roared to the sky, let go of the blue bird, turned around and pounced on the weak human being!
Bang! !
